# N8+US, Inc. — Nathan O'Brien

> N8+US, Inc. is the consulting practice of Nathan O'Brien, a creative engineering leader with 30 years driving imagination to real-world implementation. Today that work is AI-native and agentic: fractional CTO, AI architecture, and delivery. This site is his portfolio and point of contact.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://n8plusus.com/): who Nathan is and what N8+US does.
- [Portfolio](https://n8plusus.com/portfolio/): selected work, one page per project.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://n8plusus.com/resume/resume.pdf): full professional history.
